programs.title: The Toys That Built The World
programs.desc: Two chance discoveries in the 1950s turn mundane industrial materials into legendary toys. Etch A Sketch and Play-Doh will rake in billions for decades to come, but not everyone will reap the rewards.

programs.title: The Food That Built The World
programs.desc: At a time when dog food is a rarity and cat food is almost nonexistent, it will take visionary innovators to invent the first dog treat, the first cat food, and many more innovations.

programs.title: The Food That Built Asia
programs.desc: This episode delves into the history of ramen, from Asakusa's “Rairaiken,” which is said to have created the prototype for today's ramen, to the yatai ramen of the Showa period.

programs.title: Ride N' Seek: Behind The Ride
programs.desc: Jaime looks back at her Southeast Asian adventures, from animal encounters to best beaches.

programs.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: A trip to the doctor is sure to cure any afflicted individual, but what happens when even the doctors are stunned by what they see? Like a family cursed with blue skin.

programs.title: The Pickers
programs.desc: Flying solo, Mike heads to the California castle home of the Great Razooly-a sculptor, entrepreneur, and horror icon whose collection includes monsters, gargoyles, and a rocket ship on the front lawn.
